input.summary: Shelf audit (confidence 0.82) for Beverages & Snacks at Surulere Chill Store shows full compliance: all 4 planogram SKUs (Gala Sausage Roll, Beloxxi Cream Crackers, McVitie's Digestive 250g, Cabin Biscuit 200g) at expected facings, 0 stock-outs, 100% planogram share, no unknown products. No reorders proposed and no inventory lookup needed, since nothing is out or below minimum. The real issue is equipment: telemetry shows the fridge above 8°C for 40 minutes with a peak of 11.2°C, matching the auditor's 'fault' note. A technician has been dispatched at high urgency (est. ₦15,000) and the manager has been notified by WhatsApp to check the unit now, relocate chilled stock to a working fridge, and quarantine any product that has been warm too long.
